image_description: A vertical shot of a steep, sandy-colored cliff face on the left. A young boy in green shorts is captured mid-air, jumping off the cliff with arms raised. Below him, two other people stand on the rocky ground looking up. The background shows a clear blue sky and a distant horizon line over water or flat land. The rock face has visible texture and some vegetation.

The lower legs and feet lack sharp definition against the background. The ankles seem to dissolve into the air, and the foot shapes are ambiguous, lacking clear toes or shoe details.

The person in blue on the left has a somewhat 'painted' or smudged appearance. The boundaries between their clothing and body are soft and slightly unnatural, typical of AI generation struggles with smaller human figures.
The edge from which the boy jumps seems to lack physical thickness or a clear take-off point, blending slightly into the sky behind him.
